paragraphs.text:
With  careful  steps,  you  withdraw  from  the  alien  creatures. 
Every instinct urges you to run.

Make a Stealth roll for yourself and Norman. If you both succeed, 
you get clear; go to 513. If either of you fail, you do the smart thing 
and sprint; go to 476.
